title: Re: Subscription 🤮
body:
I was excited to try this app based on the features it advertised, but unfortunately, it locks almost everything behind a subscription wall right after launch. There’s barely any opportunity to explore the interface or understand the value before being asked to pay.

Instead of immediately pushing for a subscription, it would be more effective — and respectful — to offer a limited but meaningful free experience. Let users see what the app can do, enjoy it, and then decide if it’s worth upgrading.

The concept seems solid, but the aggressive subscription model turns people away before they can even try it. A freemium model done right builds trust and makes users want to support the app. Hopefully future updates improve the onboarding experience.
author: Jamesreid01
